title: The Compliance inspection chip; no-record services sort last
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor (view customers; edit customers to raise a work order), on the build under test.
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab. For the location cases use a two-workplace org (on a one-workplace org the location filter is absent).
  3. Compliance rows present, including a compliance service with no record. Seed a compliance service on an enrolled asset with no record.
custom_steps:
1. Find the Compliance inspection chip above the table and turn it on.
  2. Combine it with a tile and check the tile counts.
  3. With no tile active, find the no-record compliance service and read its row and sort position; then activate a tile and check whether it still shows.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A "Compliance inspection" chip above the table (styled like "Assigned to me" on Work Orders) shows compliance rows only; it combines with the tiles, and the tiles count what it shows.
  • A compliance service with no record appears only while no tile is active; it reads "No record", sorts last, and is excluded from every tile count.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
